terminal_blockers.finding: capture_certificate returns the raw NumPy invalid array and certificate_probe removes only the named-array mapping.  The raw ndarray survives in both certificate.parent and certificate.candidate.
terminal_blockers.effect: Plain json.dumps raises TypeError after the one-use claim.  The exception occurs outside the run_probe catch, so results.json cannot be sealed even if every scientific control passes.

terminal_blockers.finding: The frozen Decision requires every required-control exception to reject, but the runner only checks candidate regression when the parent outcome is FINITE.  Parent plus candidate exceptions can satisfy None-hash determinism and vacuous empty-record all() gates.
terminal_blockers.effect: The exact runner is not fail closed under a required fixture exception.

terminal_blockers.finding: Carrier, reconstruction, selected-state, and push-law gates inspect candidate_run1 only.  candidate_run2 is compared only by output hash and mode/mask hash.
terminal_blockers.effect: A second-run carrier or observer-record failure can pass the stated two-run probe.

terminal_blockers.finding: The runner performs one os.write and does not verify or complete a legal short write.
terminal_blockers.effect: Candidate import can begin after a truncated claim file, contrary to the durable pre-import claim invariant.

additional_v3_integrity_requirements: Remove or serialize every NumPy array/scalar from the result tree and require strict finite JSON leaves; the certificate invalid arrays already have frozen hashes and need not be retained raw.
Require parent, candidate_run1, and candidate_run2 to be non-exceptional on every required fixture; no None-hash or empty-record path may contribute to PASS.

Gate complete reset and push records for both candidate runs, including exactly 14 reset and 15 push records, and compare deterministic hashes of the complete JSON-native semantic run records in addition to output and mode/mask hashes.
Implement full write_all semantics before fsync; durably fsync the file and each directory entry created for the claim namespace before importing the candidate.
Set sys.dont_write_bytecode before third-party or workspace imports, or defer those imports until after the claim, so the declared namespace claim is the first possible workspace write.
Implement every elementwise forward-bound gate as finite arrays plus all(abs(error) <= bound); NaN must be a violation rather than passing through count_nonzero(error > bound).
Keep the V1 and V2 runners, releases, and output namespaces terminally held and use distinct V3 runner, release, independent-audit, claim, and result paths.

authority.required_next_step: Seal and independently audit a distinct corrected V3 runner/release chain before any candidate import or execution.
